user.title: Swiss Lottery
user.description: Shows the published results of a Swisslos game – the latest draw, the jackpot and the next draw – and checks your own tickets against them. Add the integration once per game.

data_description.tickets: Main numbers followed by the bonus number(s), for example «4 11 19 27 33 41 + 5» for Swiss Lotto (6 numbers + lucky number), «3 17 24 38 46 + 2 9» for EuroMillions (5 numbers + 2 stars) or «4 8 15 16 23 38 + 1» for EuroDreams (6 numbers + dream number). Commas work too; without a «+» the last number(s) count as the bonus. Tickets can be changed later under Configure.

error.cannot_connect: swisslos.ch could not be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_page: The results page of swisslos.ch does not have the expected structure. The integration may need an update.

init.description: One ticket per line: the main numbers, then «+» and the bonus number(s). Leave empty to track the draws without tickets.
